description: Divi5 Toolkit hooks for CSS validation and accessibility checks

hooks.prompt:
A file was just modified. First, check if the file is a CSS file (*.css, *.scss, *.less) or contains CSS (*.html with <style> tags, *.php with inline styles). If NOT a CSS-related file, skip entirely — do nothing.

If it IS CSS-related, check if .claude/divi5-toolkit.local.md exists and has auto_validate: true. If enabled, use the divi5-validator agent to quickly validate the CSS for Divi 5 compatibility. Keep the validation brief and non-intrusive — only report P0 (critical) issues inline. For P1/P2 issues, just mention the count and suggest running /divi5-toolkit:validate for details.

Additionally, if the CSS contains animations, transitions, or interactive element styles (buttons, links, forms), briefly check for focus indicators and prefers-reduced-motion support. If missing, add a one-line note suggesting /divi5-toolkit:audit for accessibility review.
